test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

It is terrible that education systems all over the world are being held in captivity due to poverty, both at the governmental and family levels, despite the fact that education is claimed to be so important for human progress and the _________ of global economies.
solution:
The correct answer is '**revitalisation**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**revitalisation**" means bringing new life or vigor to something. (पुनर्जीवन)
 
• In the context of global economies, revitalisation refers to the process of injecting new energy or life into the economy.
 
• The other options: "**abrogation**," "**devastation**," and "**dismantling**" do not fit the context as appropriately. They imply negative actions or consequences.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *It is terrible that education systems all over the world are being held in captivity due to poverty, both at the governmental and family levels, despite the fact that education is claimed to be so important for human progress and the revitalisation__ of global economies.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Abrogation (निरसन)**: means the repeal or abolition of a law, right, or agreement.
 
• **Devastation (विध्वंस)**: means great destruction or damage.
 
• **Dismantling (विघटन)**: means taking a structure or system apart.
